title: Preparation and performance evaluation of expanded vermiculite-based phase change materials for building thermal insulation and energy saving
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10363-10371
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09349J, Paper
Open Access

Chaoqun Fan, Hanning Zhang, Jiaxing Gao, Haiming Yang, Xifeng Lv
To meet the demand for building envelope materials with efficient heat storage and release capabilities in the harsh climate of Northwest China, this study reports the development of a novel ternary composite phase change material (CEV@SiC).
